entries.embedded_english: Hell, how many tanks do the Japanese have left?
Get going, Miller, while there's still an 8th Marine Division left out there.
Let's go!  Get to that building and take out those MGs!
2nd Marines.  Who's in charge here!
You are, I guess.  All our officers and NCOs are dead.
The longer we stay here, the more we're gonna get cut to pieces.  We need to get out of here.
Miller - work forward and find us a route out of this trench.
Hell, that place is a fortress!
We done?  Okay, let's move on.
Move inside.  Find that radar communications equipment and destroy it.
Then that settles it.  We have to knock out those guns and give the Air Force a fighting chance.  Let's go.
You all know the drill – clear out these trenches and get to those AA guns.
Keep moving.  Speead out and clear the place out.
Solid shooting, Miller.  The Air Force owe us one.
Carter?
Air battle's not won yet, Sarge.  Batallion HQ say we've got to knock out the Japanese radar station that's still co-ordinating their fighter defenses in the air.
Alright, Marines.  Still ain't earned our government paychecks today, I guess.
More Japanese over among those ruins.  Hell, they've got us cold!  Take cover.
Swell.  So we're back to being pinned down again.
Keep on going.  Hear those AA guns?  That's our objective.
Don't stop.  We knock out that gun, we help win the air battle for this island.
Hell, now we gotta do the 8th's job for 'em?
Hey, Sarge, ain't we supposed to be taking the airfield?
Look!  Someone's going for that bunker!
My God!
Aw hell!  They got him!
Miller, grab that bazooka, that's an order
We aint got all day Miller, get that bazooka
I see 'em.  Miller - take care of them.
There's more of them up on the roof.  This way, Miller!
Japanese coming out the building.  Don't stop - go right through 'em!
Good work, Miller.  Those enemy fighters will be flying blind now.
Miller, scout on ahead.  We'll cover your back.  You find those AA guns, you know what to do.
Up ahead - that the radar station?
That's the place.  We gotta get inside and shut down that radar system.
Here they come!
Japanese assault.  Hell, they're coming straight for us!
Put some suppressing fire on that Woodpecker.  Our pilots are dying up there.
They're Marines, Polonsky.   Marines are in trouble, then we go help them.  Let's move out.
Guess they must want their radar station back.
Then they can keep wanting.  Give it to 'em, Marines.
Yeah, well, the airfield's over there, and we're pinned down here, with that bunker between it and us.   You got any ideas on how we're gonna get past it, then I'm listening.
Guy's gotta be crazy!  Who is he?
He just took out the whole bunker by himself!   Move out.  Let's hive him some support!
Miller, I need help over here!
Japanese tanks!
Get inside!  Clear the place out and silence those MGs!
Wow.  Look at that!
Same old flyboys - as far above the rough stuff as they can get.
The runway could be mined.  Use those craters to get across.  Miller – lead the way.
Aw hell, we got incoming.  Japanese tank heading this way!
Carter – get on the radio.  Time to call in that favor the Air Force owe us.
Same drill.  Clear the trench.  Find the gun.
See that?  They're coming from the bunker that guy smoked.   Now we're gonn ahave them on our back too.  Sarge, we gotta get out of here!
Then we make one.  <shouting>  Marine!  Get that bazooka up here!
Cover him!
Get in there!  Move it.
Let''s go!  C'mon, Miller!
Need to get across the runway,  Move, Marines.
They're everywhere!  Get 'em!  Fire, fire, FIRE!
Woodpecker's silenced.  Take out that AA!
Get moving!  Get to that revement over the other side of the runway!
Hold your fire!  Those are friendlies from 8th Marine.
You guys with the unit that found that headquarters?
What's left of it.  The rest of our guys are up ahead and pinned down hard by MG fire.  We can't get close to the place.
If we hook up together, maybe we can change that.  Let's go.
We could always just wait for 'em to run out of bullets, or the war to finish, whichever's gonna happen first.
Whoever he is, he's out there on his own.  Give him covering fire!
Fire came from that building!    Get in there.  That poor sonovabitch opened up a hole for us - don't let it go to waste!
Miller, grab that bazooka and buy us some time, fire on those goddamn tanks.
Take cover - into the trench!
Friendlies!  We got friendly support over there!
6th Marine Division - well look who finally decided to show up for the party!
We got armor too.  Those Shermans will eat through the Japanese tanks.
Told you I'd find anyone who was out there, Sarge...
Signal from Batallion HQ, Sarge.  We've broken the back of enemy resistance on Betio.  They say the island's ours.
Yeah, this one's ours.  Still plenty of others out there that ain't, though....
Good work, Polonsky.
Hey, don't look at me, Sarge.  Thank Miller here.  Guy's turning into a real tiger--
Japanese infantry coming!
Didn't waste any time organizing a counterattack, did they?   Carter?
Already on it, Sarge.  If thre's anyone out there can send us some help, I'll find them.
Support's coming, Marines.  Just stay alive until it gets here.
Keep firing!
Keep on going.  Miller - clear the next storey.
Good job, Marines.  Now move into that trench system.
Good work, Miller.  Now let's see about doing the same to the next one.
Above us!  Japanese riflemen on the roof!
Keep moving.  Keep moving!
Woodpecker MG nest.  They got that AA covered tight.
Don't let them set up defensive positions.  Move forward on 'em!
That's it.  Keep at 'em!
More of them coming out!
Sarge, I got the 8th Division on the radio.  Some of their guys have located the Japanese headquarters, but are pinned down and need help.  Battalion says we're the nearest unit.
Carter – where's that damn air support?
Here they come  Woohoo!
Heads down!
Polonsky, one more crack from you, and--
Damn!  Will ya yake a look at that!
Yeah.  Get some payback on the Japanese who shot that guy!
Ah hell, they'e got tanks.  Enemy armor, on the horizon!
They're coming from the other side now.  Get over there, Miller.
